module: ImGui "Router Debugger" window to inspect the UI router: current route, pending route, breadcrumb, input field to navigate to a route or go back, and tree of registered routes grouped by module (prefix before the first dot). Development tool; loaded on demand (the load line in ui_router is commented out).
notes: On load, the window opens automatically unless the global disableHwWarnings is true.
Tables are displayed recursively except the "children" key.
The Navigate button calls extensions.ui_router.navigate(name) then clears the input; Back calls extensions.ui_router.back(). The last result is displayed.

dependencies.desc: Declared dependency: ui_imgui (indicated by the auto-generated page).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: requests the automatic opening of the window unless disableHwWarnings is true.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: opens the window if requested, then draws "Router Debugger" (initial size 450x600) with current route, pending route, breadcrumb, actions and route modules.

toggle.desc: Toggles the open state of the debug window.
